bandReport.notes: p00 IS the instructions cover (T.B.C. JNBY-D-GNL, Test Booklet Series A, 120 items, 2 hours, 100 marks) — not transcribed. Rendered pages carry the ENGLISH half only; printed page numbers run 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13 for p01..p06 (the even printed pages are the Hindi half and are absent from the render), so the band is contiguous with no missing English content. Q1 on p01 is the first question of the paper and is complete. Q36 is the last question in the right column of p06 and is complete (all four options printed above the [P.T.O. rule). Band edge VERIFIED against the neighbouring band's territory: p07 opens at Q37 (left column, 'Cheetahs, brought from Namibia...') and Q41 (right column), so nothing of mine spills onto p07 and nothing of p07's belongs here. Per-page counts: p01 Q1-6, p02 Q7-12, p03 Q13-17 (5 only — Q13 and Q17 are long), p04 Q18-23, p05 Q24-29, p06 Q30-36 (7). No question straddles a page break anywhere in this band and no option block splits across the column break. NO shared Directions/code block appears in Q1-36 — every question prints its own four options. THREE questions print their code options in NON-ASCENDING order (all-of-them not at (d)): Q12 (d) is '1, 3 and 4', Q23 and Q25 both put '1, 2 and 3' at (c) with a narrower set at (d). No 'How many of the above statements' count-option items in this band. No Match List (table) items in this band — Q32 is a four-pair 'not correctly matched' item, so the pairs are the options, not a List-I/List-II table. Page defects: p03 Q13 statement 1 reads 'Brown fumes of NO are released' (verified at 8x — no subscript 2; NO2 is what lead nitrate actually gives, and the same question's statement 4 does print NO2), transcribed as printed and flagged. Catalog gap: Q35 (ethnic community of Assam — Bhil/Gond/Ahom/Adi) has no tribes/ethnic-communities subtopic anywhere in the catalog; filed under Population, Census and Urbanisation and flagged.
